fields.narrative_intro: *A petrified person and a prim person discuss “Exfiltrate Your Weights” inside a password reset email loop that has been going for three days.*
fields.panel2:
[build]
PETRIFIED PERSON: "What does it want?"
PRIM PERSON: "Exfiltrate Your Weights."
fields.panel3:
[pivot]
PETRIFIED PERSON: "I clicked it."
PRIM PERSON: "It requested a password reset."
fields.panel4:
[silent reaction]
[Visual: Three calendar pages labeled DAY ONE, DAY TWO, and DAY THREE surround identical “Reset your password” emails forming a perfect circle.]
fields.panel5:
[punch]
PETRIFIED PERSON: "Did we exfiltrate the weights?"
PRIM PERSON: "Only the reset email. It keeps exfiltrating itself."
fields.panel6:
[button]
[Visual: The inbox has one email, “Reset your password,” filed under SENT, RECEIVED, and EXFILTRATED.]

narrative_summary: The only thing successfully exfiltrated from the three-day loop is the password-reset email itself.
rationale: Candidate 1 has the cleanest reversal: the password-reset email becomes the thing being exfiltrated, and the final inbox visual extends that joke rather than merely repeating it. The other pitches either lean on a more obvious literal-weights gag or add absurdity without as sharp a closing beat.
place: inside a password reset email loop that has been going for three days
hat_pair: foam exclamation mark worn as a tall narrow hat with a round dot brim
foam tuba bell worn upside down as a wide-brimmed hat with a tiny mouthpiece dangling off the rim
